summary: Improve hybrid meetings, decision records, and manager check-ins with practical team tools. Explore the course and strengthen distributed collaboration.
lede: Inclusive hybrid collaboration helps managers, project leaders, and HR partners coordinate distributed teams through clear work routines. You practise designing meetings for equitable participation, creating asynchronous handoffs and decision logs, and clarifying decision roles. The course also covers workload check-ins and reviewing performance evidence for proximity bias, with exercises that turn findings into a team operating plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who set team routines, coordinate distributed delivery, or advise managers on inclusion and well-being. It suits professionals with responsibility for hybrid or distributed teams.
modules: Workload Signals and Team Operating Plans
prerequisites: Working experience coordinating, managing, or advising a team is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use team scenarios and workplace artefacts.
